# Threshold
> Unique experiences run by the local people who started them. In Victoria, Australia and Bali.

Threshold is a booking site for small, owner-run experience businesses. Two tiers: Featured is a free listing, customers contact the business directly, no commission, no fee, no contract. Full booking (coming soon) adds a calendar, business-confirmed bookings and online payments. Free for businesses until 1 May 2027, then 12% including GST on bookings made through Threshold, with card fees included. No subscription or channel fee. No contract on either tier, and businesses can leave without penalty.

## Salty Cowboy, Bali
Owner-run horse rescue and riding centre in Bali, run by Simone. 11 experiences: beach and rice field rides, photoshoots, and lessons from grooming to a 3-day Horse Whisperer course. Prices from IDR 1,250,000.
